label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value is generated using java.lang.Math.random(), which is insecure randomness. The rememberMeKey is derived from Math.random() and used in a cookie, making it vulnerable to prediction attacks. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value includes user-provided values from getName() and getValue() functions, which are directly concatenated into the HTTP response without proper encoding. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.
